content.intro: In this lesson, you will study default and static interface methods with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.
content.why_it_matters: This concept matters because it helps you choose between inheritance, interfaces, and composition based on the relationship being modeled. In this lesson, focus on default methods and use a minimal example to check what the rule actually guarantees.

items.title: Resolving conflicting inherited defaults
items.text: Inheritance models a substitutable “is-a” relationship, interfaces define contracts, and composition connects collaborators. Polymorphic calls use the runtime object’s override rather than the reference variable’s declared class. Apply that reasoning specifically to resolving conflicting inherited defaults and confirm the result with the example or a targeted test.
